# Sample Inventory API

| Endpoint | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /health` | Health check |
| `HEAD /health` | Cheap health check |
| `GET /api/users/42` | Fetch one user |
| `POST /api/users` | Create a user |
| `DELETE /items/{id}` | Remove an item |
| `GET /api/reports/:id` | Next.js route handler |

```http
GET /api/users/7 HTTP/1.1
```
